card.name: "In" before divided-dose portions
card.fires_on: The word "in" (or a following "two"/"small") right after a daily amount or an instruction to add water, where it introduces splitting into portions, parts or equal doses.

modes.label: Daily dose split
modes.description: "in" after a per-day dosage, leading to divided or equal doses.
modes.example: The recommended dosage is 20 to 40 mg/kg/day<< in>> 3 or 4 equal doses.

modes.label: Water added in portions
modes.description: "in" or "two" after an instruction to add water to a powder, leading to portions.
modes.example: Add 34 mL of water in<< two>> portions.
